title: GScript v1
features:
- Backflip Features (K, L)
[Requireds Infinite Yield to Edit the JumpPower]
- Creators ESP Choice
   - Tapes (Fixed)
   - Twisteds
   - Medkit
   - Bandage
   - JumperCable
   - Generators
   - Players
   - Research
   - Extraction Speed Candy
   - Holiday Collectible Item (Still working when a Season Event came.)
- Collide
(Shows the Red Collisions in the Map on the Objects & Can Resize the Collide Parts)
- Platform
(Can Instance It, Change Heights, Platform Sizes)
[You need a Jumppower to get on the Platform after you Instance it! and safe to use than the fly thing because its bannable or often get patched by the devs.]
- Monsters (Twisteds)
(Shows the Coming Twisteds in the Map, Shows Medkit and Bandages by using the HUD.)
- BAX
   - Ad Blocker
   - Freshener (Removes the Ichor on the Screen only!)
   -  Light Vision (Fullbright)
   - Pollen Removal (for Easter Event Only!)
- Mobile
   - Shows the Button (ShiftLock, K-L Flip Binds, J Jump, TPWalk Trigger)
[Often its out of the Screen on Mobile and it only shwos the ShiftLock and J, K, L Buttons]
